views.label: No arithmetic at all
views.note: The module holds one shape and nothing else. There is nothing here to work out.

views.label: Why it earns a name
views.note: A place on a plane comes up often enough here to be worth a name of its own.

views.label: The only fault it can have
views.note: Passing two loose values lets a caller pass them the wrong way round. A name is what stops that.

views.label: Who takes one
views.note: A peak at a place and a height, a reading from two axes, a point of a curve being fitted.

cards.title: What it holds
items: There is no arithmetic here at all

cards.title: Why it earns a name
items: A peak at a place and a height
A reading from two axes, or a point of a curve being fitted
A place on a plane comes up in enough of this library to be worth naming

cards.title: The only fault it can have
items: Passing two loose values lets a caller pass them the wrong way round
Giving the pair a name is what keeps that from happening
Nothing else here can go wrong, because nothing else here is done
